title: Low-Cal Italian Vego Sausages
subtitle: with Caponata and Mashed Potato
description: It's bangers and mash – but not as you know them. These are vegan: with plant-based sun-dried tomato sausages, mashed potato, and an eggplant, zucchini and tomato sauce known as caponata.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Cut half the eggplant into 1cm chunks. Cut the zucchini into 1cm chunks. Pick the parsley leaves and finely chop the stems, keeping them separate. Peel the potato, then cut into 3cm chunks. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves.

Make mash: Put the potato in a medium saucepan of cold salted water and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook for 10-12 mins until tender. Drain well and return to the pan. Mash the potato until smooth, then add 2 tsp olive oil, season with salt and pepper and stir until well combined. Cover to keep warm.

Start caponata: Meanwhile, heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the parsley stems and garlic, stirring, for 1 min or until fragrant. Add the eggplant and zucchini and cook, stirring, for 2-3 mins until slightly softened.

Simmer caponata: Add half the tomatoes, 2 tsp tomato paste and 125ml (½ cup) water to the veggies. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat to medium and cook for 6-8 mins until the veggies are tender. Stir in 2 tsp red wine vinegar and season with salt and pepper. Remove the pan from the heat.

Cook sausages and serve: Meanwhile, heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the sausages, turning regularly, for 6 mins or until browned and warmed through (see Kitchen 101). Divide the mash among plates. Top with the sausages and caponata. Scatter over the sunflower seeds and parsley leaves. Enjoy!
Kitchen 101: These sausages are fragile, so take care when cooking and turning them in the pan. Keep the sausages separate in the pan, as they can stick together if touching.
